title: sf-build configuration v1
description: What a product or an extension author commits beside a SIMAI Framework package folder so that `sf-build` can build it. Relative paths are resolved against the directory that holds the configuration file. Options given on the command line or to the Node API override the file.

$schema.description: Optional editor hint; ignored by sf-build.

name.description: The package name: the key of SF_BOOT_CONFIG.packages and the name the package rule file registers.

kind.description: The kind of extension: a component package (simai.component-package) or a theme package (framework.lock.json and theme.json: the Framework's eight palettes made from one colour). utility and composition-type packages are reserved for later versions of this schema.

path.description: The package folder (it holds framework.lock.json and src/smart/<folder>/). Default: the directory of the configuration file.

revision.description: The commit of the package repository to build. Default: HEAD. The build always reads committed files, never the working tree.

repository.description: The repository id recorded in the receipt, for example simai/larena. Default: owner/name of the origin GitHub remote.

source.description: A ui-source checkout that holds the revision the package pins in framework.lock.json. Overridden by --ui-source and SF_BUILD_UI_SOURCE.

ui.description: Optional ui checkout: the receipt resolves the free release built from the pinned revision and checks the package against it. Overridden by --ui and SF_BUILD_UI.

out.description: The output path: the directory the built package is laid into (<out>/smart/..., package-receipt.json, package-<name>.tar).

workspace.description: A directory, new for every run, for the two build waves. Default: a new temporary directory, removed after a successful run that lays an output.
